message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with white and black text. At the top, the word "TEMPO" is written in large white serif letters, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below. Three men are positioned around a cylindrical gray structure labeled "PERTAMINA" with a multicolored logo. The structure's top surface appears flat and misty. 

In the upper left, a man wearing a black cap, glasses, white scarf, and blue jacket smiles with clenched fists. To his right, a man in a white collared shirt and black pants leans forward, gripping the edge of the cylinder; he has a mustache and wears white sneakers with blue and red stripes. In the foreground, a man in a dark suit is seen from behind, also leaning toward the cylinder. 

White text on the right reads "SALING SILANG DEPO PLUMPANG," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Pemerintah terbelah..." and ending with "H.68". Additional text at the top mentions "Putusan Penundaan Pemilu," "Pejabat Bea-Cukai," and "Pebisnis Mobil Mewah." A barcode and date "13-19 MARET 2023" are in the upper right.
